# Hexacomb

> Hexacomb shares information about website design, local SEO, hosting, and ongoing website care for small businesses in Fresno, Clovis, and California’s Central Valley.

Based in Clovis, California, Hexacomb is Marco Chavez’s independent, website-focused marketing agency. The site explains its services, care plans, selected work, and approach to working directly with business owners.

## Core Content

- [Website Design & Development](https://hexacombllc.com/website-design) — Website design, copy, and development focused on clear next steps for customers.
- [Local SEO & Search Visibility](https://hexacombllc.com/local-seo) — Local SEO, service pages, and clear business information to help customers and search systems understand what a business does and where it operates.
- [Hosting & Care Plans](https://hexacombllc.com/pricing) — Website hosting, maintenance, updates, and ongoing support.
- [About Marco Chavez](https://hexacombllc.com/about) — Background on the founder and Hexacomb’s direct, personal approach.
- [Selected Work](https://hexacombllc.com/work) — Examples of Hexacomb’s website projects.

## Optional

- [Hexacomb homepage](https://hexacombllc.com/) — Agency overview, service summaries, client reviews, and contact information.
